dataset_name: The Health Gym v2.0 Synthetic Antiretroviral Therapy (ART) for HIV Dataset

sde_bench_run.evaluation_scope: sampled first 600 source rows because full privacy nearest-reference comparison is quadratic in current SDE-Bench
sde_bench_run.export_command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m sde_bench health-gym-export --input data/public_raw/health_gym/HealthGymV2_CbdrhDatathon_ART4HIV.csv --out-dir reports/public_benchmarks/health_gym --format jsonl --limit 600
sde_bench_run.evaluate_command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m sde_bench evaluate --real reports/public_benchmarks/health_gym/reference.jsonl --synthetic reports/public_benchmarks/health_gym/synthetic.jsonl --source reports/public_benchmarks/health_gym/source.jsonl --target diagnosis_group --sensitive sex,ethnicity --json-out reports/public_benchmarks/health_gym/report.json --md-out reports/public_benchmarks/health_gym/report.md
